h33-h33-2-b2-CONC_C10_b5km-20261023-3127.hypothesis: At fixed mass, the marginal fault yield per dot is higher inside 5 km blocks where the parent's own geophysical evidence surface is strong, so moving 10% of the budget out of the weakest blocks into the strongest blocks raises distance-tolerant fault detection.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONC_C10_b5km-20261023-3127.mechanism: The 300 m triangular kernel rewards covering continuous, strongly expressed lineaments: one dot inside a dense scarp segment converts several truth pixels at once, which is the regime in which a dot pays for its 0.2 denominator cost. R0's Poisson-disk thinning instead spaces dots evenly along every H19-5 ridge regardless of how strongly that ridge is expressed in TMI/gravity gradient and slope, so block mean evidence and block dot count are only partly aligned.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONC_C10_b5km-20261023-3127.non_fault_mimic: TMI and gravity horizontal-gradient highs and steep slope also mark lithologic contacts, dikes, caldera ring fractures and erosional scarps, so the strongest blocks can be geophysically loud and structurally barren; the destination pixels are also the thinned-away neighbours of surviving dots, which are partly redundant.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONC_C10_b5km-20261023-3127.predicted_sign_and_size: MODEL:-0.001 vs R0, scenario range [-0.021,+0.011]; MODEL only, not a score. The two local instruments disagree in sign: the SGMC off-catalogue control, which is the closer analogue of new-fault truth, falls monotonically with dose (-0.004851 here), while the catalogue hide-and-recover holdout, which scores known faults the organisers mask out, rises by about +0.0018 at every dose.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONC_C10_b5km-20261023-3127.falsifier: A receipt gain of at least +0.01 over R0 at any dose would reject the reading that R0's block allocation is already locally optimal and would vindicate the hide-and-recover instrument over the SGMC control. A loss materially worse than [-0.021,+0.011] at 10% would show the refill pixels degrade faster than either local instrument indicates, and would also rule out combining this axis with anything else.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONC_C10_b5km-20261023-3127.decision_rule: Treat absolute live change <0.01 as no evidence; compare only human-provided receipt scores.
